author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, I’m breaking down my hands-on experience with Intel’s upcoming Panther Lake chips and what they could mean for handheld gaming PCs. Most of what we’ve seen so far is in laptops and mini PCs, but Intel’s hinting at something bigger—possibly custom Panther Lake chips designed specifically for handhelds.Intel Panther Lake is almost here, and after going hands-on at CES, I’m seriously impressed with what this new iGPU can do. If Intel really goes all-in on Panther Lake handheld gaming PCs, things could get very interesting.
